notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token for each Goblin you control.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing a Goblin token.
Krenko triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
